messages:
maria-sales: FYI POC with ValoraRetail — streaming responses from our Python SDK are intermittently duplicated after a proxy 502. Customer sees two identical first chunks after a retry. Theyre worried about billing and stateful consumers. Call in 20m.
leon-eng: do we have a short reproduction from their side (curl / python)? Is this via HTTPS through a corporate TLS-terminating proxy or a transparent forward proxy?
maria-sales: their infra team says it's an edge TLS proxy (terminates and re-originates) and they use connection pooling. Customer attached a short Python log.
customer-simran: pasted log: 
```
2026-04-01T09:15:01Z GET /v1/stream 200 chunked
2026-04-01T09:15:08Z proxy: 502 Bad Gateway (upstream reset)
2026-04-01T09:15:08Z client: retrying request (attempt=2)
2026-04-01T09:15:08Z client: received chunk id=abc123 data="{...first part...}"
2026-04-01T09:15:09Z client: received chunk id=abc123 data="{...first part...}"
```
They say the SDK retries automatically and their consumer sees the duplicate chunk.
tariq-ps: likely causes: 1) client-level retry on socket errors without idempotency; 2) proxy reusing a pooled socket to a different backend and reissuing an in-flight request; 3) server emitted a partial chunk then connection reset so retry caused replay.
leon-eng: for Python sdk suggestions: ensure streaming request uses `stream=True`, disable urllib3 automatic retry for stream connections, and set adapter with `pool_connections=1, pool_maxsize=1` or set `Connection: close` for that route. Example: 
```
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
s = requests.Session()
s.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=1, pool_maxsize=1, max_retries=0))
resp = s.get(url, stream=True, timeout=(5, None), headers={'Connection':'keep-alive','X-Idempotency-Key': uuid})
for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=None):
    handle(chunk)
```
Also recommend adding `X-Stream-Seq` or `X-Idempotency-Key` per request so duplicates are detectable.
anya-devex: propose quick checklist for customer to try pre-call: 
- disable client-side automatic retries for streaming endpoints;
- reduce connection pooling (or `Connection: close`) to avoid proxy reusing sockets mid-stream;
- add heartbeat small chunk every 4-5s to prevent proxy idle reset;
- add sequence header `X-Stream-Seq` and idempotency key to dedupe at consumer;
- reproduce with curl: `curl -v -x https://edge-proxy:443 -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream"`
relay-bot: Created support incident SR-2026-0770-VALORA. Attached tcpdump and edge-proxy traces.
maria-sales: customer asked if we can put a temporary relay (ourside of their proxy) to terminate streaming and forward over a persistent connection to them. Whats the fastest path?
tariq-ps: fastest: spin up a short-lived dedicated relay in their nearby region, terminate streaming there and provide a smaller, proxied short-poll/long-poll endpoint to their gateway (less likely to be reset). We can also enable server-side dedupe for the POC if they accept a header-based approach.
leon-eng: server-side mitigation: attach `X-Redwood-Stream-Id` to each stream and treat retries with same id+sequence as duplicates (drop duplicates). For POC we can enable permissive dedupe for 2 minutes window. Not ideal for production but ok for trial.
maria-sales: Ops/PS credit note: can we offer 2 weeks of relay credit + engineer assist? Tariq/jess please confirm.
tariq-ps: yes propose 2-week relay credit and 4 engineering hours to implement dedupe. I'll draft language.
customer-simran: we'll attempt the client changes now (disable retries / set pool to 1 / add heartbeat). If that fails wed like the relay option.
leon-eng: also suggest they log `X-Request-ID` and TCP connection id on client and proxy so we can correlate. Add `X-Redwood-Stream-Id` to server responses to help mapping.
maria-sales: action items: leon to post the python reproducer and a short `requests` adapter snippet, anya to send debug checklist to customer, tariq to draft PS credit wording, relay-bot to attach traces.
relay-bot: Traces and pcap uploaded: /attachments/SR-2026-0770-VALORA/traces.zip
customer-simran: thank you everyone, starting tests now — will update in 10m. :pray:
